hero-title:
You took the trip.
Now make the vlog.
hero-sub: Bring your travel footage. Vease helps you pick shots, shape a story, and cut a roughly one-minute vlog. Preview it, say what you want changed, and approve the export.
hero-note: For Apple Silicon Macs · Private beta
hero-req: Install and start editing. No extra tools or runtime setup needed.
workflow-title: Your footage to a vlog, one approval at a time
workflow-desc: AI gives you a starting point. Preview it, ask for changes, and approve before moving on.
step1-desc: Drop a travel footage folder into the app. It organizes your shots and leaves the original files untouched.
step2-desc: AI adds descriptions, tags, and quality scores, and turns speech into searchable text.
step3-desc: See which shots tell the story and in what order. Adjust the outline before the cut begins.
step4-desc: Preview several AI storylines and choose the one closest to your vision.
step5-desc: Ask for a section to be shortened to 10 seconds. AI revises that part, and you can undo the change.
step6-desc: Happy with the preview? Export your video with captions and consistent audio levels, ready to share.
shots-title: Your footage. Your story. In view.
shot1-step: Steps 01–02 · Import footage / AI shot logging
shot2-step: Steps 04–05 · AI rough cut / Revise with feedback
shot1-alt: Project browser importing footage, with AI shot logging progress
shot1-caption: AI adds descriptions and tags as your footage is imported. Follow the progress and find shots more easily.
shot2-alt: Rough-cut workspace with outline and clips, a visual storyline, feedback, and inspector
shot2-caption: Ask for a section to be shortened to 10 seconds. AI revises it for you to preview and approve.
highlights-title: Skip the hours of sorting through footage
highlights-desc: Start with an AI first cut, then make it the story you want to tell.
feature1-title: A first cut to build on
feature1-desc: Unsure where to start? Let AI organize your shots, suggest an outline, and make a first cut. Then decide what stays and what needs work.
feature2-title: Original footage stays on your Mac
feature2-desc: Originals stay local, read-only, and are never uploaded. The editing AI runs on your Mac. Cloud shot logging receives up to 3 compressed keyframes per shot. Uploaded frames are retained long-term in private storage readable only by the operator.
feature3-desc: Begin with a folder of footage. The tools for processing clips and exporting your video are built in.
feature4-title: Ask for the change you want
feature4-desc: Tell AI to shorten a section. It revises that part, records the change, and lets you undo it.
download-title: Turn your next trip into a vlog worth sharing
download-desc: Open your travel footage folder and let Vease help with the first cut. An invitation code is required to use the beta app.
